intro.en: Comparing amounts: more books than, as many hours as, more than a hundred, the same as.

tantas horas como.nota: Tanto agrees with the noun: tanto, tanta, tantos, tantas.

el mismo.nota: It agrees: la misma, los mismos, las mismas.

texto.en:
With **nouns**: **más** / **menos** + noun + **que**: tengo **más** libros **que** tú.

As much, as many: **tanto, tanta, tantos, tantas** + noun + **como**. It agrees with the noun: **tantas** horas **como** tú.

With **verbs**: trabaja **más que** yo; gana **menos que** yo; no gasto **tanto como** tú.

Before a **number**, than is **de**, not que: **más de** cien euros, **menos de** mil.

The same: **el mismo** horario **que** tú; **la misma** profesora.

Also: **igual que**, **diferente de**, **parecido a**, **el doble**, **la mitad**.

filas: verb + más / menos que, tanto como

frases.en: Do you work as many hours as your brother?

frases.es: No, él trabaja más que yo, pero gana menos.
frases.en: No, he works more than me, but he earns less.

frases.es: Menos de mil euros. Yo gano el doble.
frases.en: Less than a thousand euros. I earn double.

frases.es: Yo tengo el mismo horario que tú, pero no gasto tanto como tú.
frases.en: I have the same hours as you, but I don't spend as much as you.

frases.es: Es que mi piso cuesta más de ochocientos euros.
frases.en: The thing is, my flat costs more than eight hundred euros.

pregunta.en: Complete: I have as many books as you.
Complete: it costs more than a hundred euros.

de.en: Before a number, than is de.

que.en: Que is used when you compare two things.

como.en: Como goes with tan and tanto.

pregunta.en: Complete: I work as much as you.

que.en: Que goes with más and menos.

pregunta.en: Complete: we have the same teacher. (la profesora)

lo.en: Lo mismo is the same thing, with no noun.

traduccion.en: I don't spend as much as you.

texto.en:
**The app cannot check this part.** For the writing, please use pen and paper. For the speaking, say it out loud and, if you can, practise with a native speaker or a teacher who can correct you.

**Write (60–80 words).** Write comparisons of equality about you and a friend: Trabajo tanto como…, tengo tantos… como…

**Speak (about 1 minute).** Compare aloud life now and life ten years ago using tan… como and tanto… como.
